p: cherubim there appeared over them as: Which in Eze 1:5 he called the four beasts.
the city: This signified that the city would be burnt.
went up from the cherub: Meaning that the glory of God would depart from the temple.
sound of the cherubim's wings was: Read Eze 1:24.
turned not as they went: Until they had executed God's judgments.
spirit of the living being was: There was one consent between the cherubims and the wheels.
Then the glory of the LORD: Read Eze 9:3.
living being that I saw under: That is, the whole body of the four beasts or cherubims.
